findings.title: Demo runs overwrite private work and evict saved cases
findings.why_it_matters: Running the newly added family, routines or own-case demo in the administrator's ordinary browser reads and writes the same private owner workspace. The recipes save sample input over existing drafts; a successful routines build clears its people and history, and own-case approval inserts a demo into the twelve-case private list and evicts its oldest real case. A pre-existing own-case preview can also satisfy the recipe's readiness checks immediately and be captured as the demo while the new request is still pending. The existing three-gate memory storage used by continuity and participation prevents this combination only for those two tools.
findings.suggested_fix: Before any workspace read in family-bridge-ui.js, routines-ui.js and the practice own-case IIFE, select fresh memory storage only when demolab=1, the page is embedded and homeUrl is admin.html?role=sys; route every workspace read/write, including the routines Studio import, through it. Preserve normal owner storage outside those three gates. Exercise the actual recipes with seeded private drafts, twelve saved cases and a saved preview; prove both successful and failed demos leave ordinary records byte-identical and cannot capture private content or accept an old preview.

findings.title: Switching routines sends a pending result into another item
findings.why_it_matters: A teacher can start building routine A, switch to routine B through the still-active hub, and receive A's result in B. The completion assigns through the mutable global I after the wait, replacing B's plan and clearing its people, trials, decisions and version history while A remains unfinished. Options and revision requests use the same mutable target, so this also misfiles proposals and feedback between routines. Capturing the requested item and checking its continued existence and revision makes the response belong to its initiating workspace.
findings.suggested_fix: Capture an item identity/reference and an operation or revision token before each options/build/revise await. Apply the result only to that initiating item if it still exists and the token is current, and redraw/navigate only when that item is still selected. Invalidate outstanding operations when an item is deleted or regenerated; do not let an older request unlock or update a newer request's controls. Verify deferred-provider sequences for A-to-B switching and deleting A, including preservation of B's existing plan, people and history.
